Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <dhoffman.5...@cris.com>,
Daniel Hoffman <dhof...@cris.com> wrote:
>Does lucky blow work on allies? Can the MVH do 5 first strike damage? Can
>the renegade garou do an extra +1? Well, what if the slashers want to
>increase their 1R strike to 2R? What if a mage wants to change 2R to 3R?
>What if Lazarus or the Ghoul Retainer use it? Is it 2R and 2 respectively?

Yes, Yes, No, No, No, and No.

MVH: Yes. Any non-ranged inherent strike is considered a hand strike.
Garou: Yes. same reasoning.
Slashers: No. Ranged strikes are never considered hand strikes (unless hitherto
non-existent card text says otherwise, of course).
Mage: No. same reasoning.
Lazarus: No. same reasoning.
Ghoul Retainer: No. does not strike, so may not use any strike cards.
